position_rules.Q1_GRID: ceil_cube_root(N) grid cell centers; first N lexicographic triples; disclose incomplete slab for noncubic N
position_rules.Q2_HALTON: radical inverse bases 2,3,5; indices 1..N; no scramble or seed
position_rules.Q4_RANK1: centered rank-1 rational points (k+1/2, (3k mod N)+1/2, (5k mod N)+1/2)/N
position_rules.Q3: REFUSED: same-state experimental g(r)/S(q) and uncertainties unavailable; no ideal gas curve relabelled as measured structure

momentum_rules.P1_CARTESIAN_QUANTILES: positive normal midpoint quantiles (1/2+(j+1/2)/N), three fixed bijections of N/2 entries, then exact negative pairs
momentum_rules.P2_RADIAL_SPHERE_ANTIPODAL: Maxwell speed midpoint quantiles (j+1/2)/(N/2); Fibonacci upper-hemisphere directions rationally projected to unit sphere, then exact negative pairs
momentum_rules.position_assignment: sort generated geometry lexicographically; attach momentum list before any storage labels; no supplied atom ID is an algorithm input
momentum_rules.energy_policy: no after-generation rescaling, no residual dumped on last particle; record K and Tkin using 3(N-1) COM-free degrees of freedom
momentum_rules.exact_energy_shell_candidate: discuss separately only; not executed or approved

arithmetic: Fraction plus local Decimal precision 70; fixed 240-term erf series and 128 bisections; coefficient representatives on a predeclared 10^-30 rational grid; symbolic cube/square roots for physical q/p scales
sphere_rule: z=(j+1/2)/(N/2); phi=j*pi*(3-sqrt(5)); fixed Taylor cos/sin, stereographic rational projection; both poles and antipodes have explicit ties
diagnostics: pair squared-distance CDF in finite cube
spatial_proxy_reference: 32^3 fixed midpoint quadrature of independent uniform points in a finite cube; not experimental g(r), not PBC
minimum_separation_interpretation: compatibility diagnostic with current undefined PES floor, not a physical hard-core law

success_criteria.technical: repeat bytes identical; exact sum p=0; no source mutation accepted; no ID-dependent assignment; unsupported inputs/ties follow fixed rule; no repair or forward dynamics
success_criteria.reality_feasibility_A: requires same-point experimental density/EOS and structural statistics with uncertainties, isotope mapping and a justified preparation law; no missing field/ASSUMED proxy may be silently upgraded
success_criteria.proxy_statistics: report raw discrepancy, anisotropy and N trends for all candidates; no pass threshold chosen to make a candidate win; no winner selected

final_verdict_policy: E if bounded survey cannot close reality-only inputs; keep conditional numerical experiments separately labelled
scope: SURVEY_ONLY; NOT AN OBSERVED MICROSTATE; C1-C D5 PENDING
